{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales_df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop refunded orders
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute the conversion rate difference within each customer segment
# We'll compute: (email_conversion - paid_search_conversion) for each segment
segment_differences = {}
for segment in sales_df['customer_segment'].unique():
    subset = sales_df[sales_df['customer_segment'] == segment]
    email_conv = subset[subset['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
    paid_search_conv = subset[subset['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()
    diff = email_conv - paid_search_conv
    segment_differences[segment] = diff

# Compute weighted average of differences, weighted by size of email group in each segment
email_sizes = sales_df[sales_df['channel'] == 'email']['customer_segment'].value_counts()

weighted_diff = 0
for segment, diff in segment_differences.items():
    weight = email_sizes[segment] / email_sizes.sum()
    weighted_diff += weight * diff

# Return the final effect estimate
weighted_diff"}
